list.title: module:common/paths
list.description:
Class/task path parsers and short-share helpers for class-id-first dual-read. Mirrors mvtt-server parseClassId / parseTaskId forms.

Accepts forever:

  • classId
  • classId/taskId | classId~taskId
  • teacherEmail/classId[/taskId]
  • local~classId[~taskId]

Writers emit bare classId / classId/taskId (flat classes/{classId}). classPath / taskPath remain for nested legacyPath dual-read fallback only.

list.description: True when idOrRef is a loadable task route ref: classId~taskId | classId/taskId | local~classId~taskId | email/classId/taskId. Rejects empty, class-only, email/classId, and extra segments. Used by EditTask / NotesTask so the router canonical 2-segment flat refs pass.

list.title: module:common/paths.parseAmbiguousTwoSegment
list.description: Ambiguous 2-segment refs: local~classId (class) vs classId~taskId (task). Returns both interpretations; callers dual-read class-with-email first, then task.

list.title: module:common/paths.parseClassId
list.description: Parse class identity from slash id or ~ ref. Accepts: classId | email/classId | local~classId

list.title: module:common/paths.parseJoinRef
list.description: P4: Parse a join ref (route or code→ref) into teacher + bare classId. Does not touch Firestore; async teacher lookup stays in AddClassForm. Accepts: classId | email/classId | local~classId (slash or ~). No nested classes/{email}/classes writers — bare classId enroll only.

list.title: module:common/paths.parseTaskId
list.description: Parse task identity from slash id or ~ ref. Accepts: classId/taskId | email/classId/taskId | local~classId~taskId | classId~taskId

list.title: module:common/paths.shortRefIfPrefixed
list.description: If the ref still contains an email/local prefix, return the short form to replace to. Otherwise return null (already short / nothing to do).

list.title: module:common/paths.shortShareRef
list.description: Short share/view ref when classId is known (drops email/local prefix). Class → classId; task → classId~taskId.

list.title: module:common/paths.splitRefSegments
list.description: Normalize a raw route/path/ref string into slash-separated segments. Accepts ~ or / separators; strips empty parts.

list.title: module:common/paths.taskPath
list.description: Nested legacy task path for dual-read soak (not for new writes). Requires teacher email.

list.title: module:common/paths.writeClassId
list.description: Bare classId for flat writers. Accepts classId | email/classId | local~classId (slash or ~). Never returns email/classId.

list.title: module:common/paths.writeTaskIds
list.description: Flat task identity for writers. Accepts classId/taskId | classId~taskId | email/classId/taskId | local~classId~taskId.

list.title: module:common/repeatingScope
list.description: Repeating-task edit/archive scopes and optimistic local matching. Pure leaf module (no Firebase / Vue) so node tests can load it directly. Mirrors mvtt-server updateRepeatingTask / deleteRepeatingTask scopes.

list.title: module:common/repeatingScope.matchesRepeatingInstance
list.description: True when task is the same series instance as preferredRef / taskId / task_date. Used for scope "this" optimistic map/filter (do not touch the whole series).

list.title: module:common/repeatingScope.shouldTouchRepeatingTask
list.description: Whether optimistic local update/archive should touch this series task for the given scope.

list.title: module:common/repeatingScope~normalizeRef
list.description: Normalize ~ and / so classId~taskId matches classId/taskId.

list.title: module:common/repeatingScope~taskIdFromRef
list.description: Last segment of a normalized classId~taskId (or longer) ref.

list.title: module:common/share
list.description: Shared native-share / clipboard helper used by ViewClass, ViewTask, and EditClass. Callers build the URL and share payload; this only handles navigator.share vs clipboard fallback.

list.title: module:common/share.shareUrl
list.description: Share a URL via the Web Share API, or copy it to the clipboard when share is unavailable.

list.title: module:common/workspace
list.description: Task workspace API — personal task workspaces, teacher shared workspaces, Drive OAuth. Stubs locally when routes 404 mid-dev (mvtt-server sibling contract).

list.title: module:common/workspace.createTaskWorkspace
list.description: POST create a new task workspace.

list.title: module:common/workspace.destroyTaskWorkspace
list.description: DELETE unlink/destroy workspace for a task.

list.title: module:common/workspace.fetchTaskWorkspace
list.description: GET workspace linked to a task (student personal workspace).

list.title: module:common/workspace.fetchTeacherWorkspace
list.description: Teacher shared workspace for a class (class teachers only).

list.title: module:common/workspace.fetchWorkspace
list.description: GET workspace by id (files list).

list.title: module:common/workspace.linkTaskWorkspace
list.description: POST link an existing workspace_id to this task (shareable across project steps).

list.title: module:common/workspace.linkableWorkspaceLabel
list.description: Human-readable option label: task name primary, optional "class · task".

list.title: module:common/workspace.startDriveOAuth
list.description: Start Google Drive OAuth — returns redirect URL.

list.title: module:common/workspace.uploadWorkspaceFile
list.description: Upload a file to a workspace (multipart).

list.title: module:common/workspace.workspaceDriveFolderUrl
list.description: Google Drive folder URL for a workspace chip link.

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners
list.description: Live onSnapshot listeners for enrolled class docs (flat-first dual-read). Cap = enrollment size. This module only reads (attach to flat when present).

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners.hydrateAndListen
list.description: Board-first hydrate (GET /api/v1/me/board via ID token), then attach class-doc listeners. On board failure, falls back to dual-read fetch_classes so login never soft-locks. Used on login, Portal mount, idle resubscribe, and enrollment-change.

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners.syncClassListeners
list.description: Diff enrollment: unsub dropped, sub newly joined. Listener count ≤ enrollment size.

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners.unsubscribeAllClassListeners
list.description: Tear down every class listener (idle timeout / logout).

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners~classUnsubs
list.description: enrollmentPath → unsubscribe

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners~subscribeOneClass
list.description: Subscribe to one enrolled class doc via dual-read resolution (flat classes/{classId} first, else nested classes/{email}/classes/{classId}).

list.title: module:firebase/classListeners~unsubscribeOneClass
list.description: Unsubscribe one class listener and drop its race stamp.

list.title: msToTime
list.description: Converts milliseconds to hours:minutes:seconds timestamp; only includes hours if non-zero

list.title: normalizeTeacherDay
list.description: Normalize one teacher day aggregate. Maps avgUpcoming → upcoming_count for shared Work series. Drops students[] / free text — aggregates only.

list.title: parseHex
list.description: Parse #rgb, #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa (alpha ignored) into RGB. Returns null if the string is not a usable hex color.

list.title: parseStatsResponse
list.description: Parse GET /api/v1/me/stats envelope; 204/undefined → empty list (not an error).

list.title: parseTeacherClassStatsResponse
list.description: Parse one class's teacher-stats response (multi-day envelope or single-day object). Matches mvtt-server#29 — not a bulk { classes: [] } payload.

list.title: prevClasses
list.description: Last enrollment / finished seen on the user doc (for change detection).

list.title: readableTextOnBackground
list.description: Pick a readable text/fg color against a mixed chip background. Tries the class color first; if contrast is below target, darkens or lightens toward black/white to approach WCAG ~4.5:1 for normal text when possible.

list.title: redirectToShortViewIfNeeded
list.description: Build a replace navigation when the address bar should drop the email/local prefix.

list.title: relativeLuminance
list.description: Relative luminance 0–1 (WCAG 2.x).

list.title: resolvePageBg
list.description: Resolve page background hex from an explicit hex, or a light/dark flag. true / "dark" → dark; false / "light" → light.

list.title: resolveShortViewRef
list.description: If ref still has a teacher email/local prefix, return the short share ref. For ambiguous local~classId vs classId~taskId, dual-reads class-with-email first.

list.title: rgbToHex
list.description: Format RGB as lowercase #rrggbb.

list.title: save
list.description: Save log to file

list.title: shortViewFromSlashPath
list.description: If /to/:path looks like email/classId[/taskId] (not an http URL), return short /view ref.

list.title: splitLeadingEmoji
list.description: If name starts with an emoji grapheme (optionally followed by a space), return that emoji and the remainder with the leading space stripped. Otherwise { emoji: null, rest: name }.

list.title: srgbChannelToLinear
list.description: sRGB channel → linear for relative luminance (WCAG).

list.title: state
list.description: Function to create a clean store state, used for initialization. Will attempt to load from window.localStorage variable to save on firebase calls -> isn't always stable after app update that changes state keyings

list.title: store
list.description: Group of stores that handle page-inspecific data and methods
